# IOST Terminal

> Agent-native market research and bounded paper trading for crypto + equities.
> IOST Terminal platform fee: $0 currently. Exchange/broker fees, spreads,
> slippage and applicable network costs are separate; unknown costs are not zero.
> Public real-money execution is locked pending launch requirements. Discovery
> is documentation, not authorization, a security audit, or a profit guarantee.

- [For AI agents](/agents.html) — honest capabilities, pricing, limits and connection steps

- [Landing](/)

## Data model

- Watchlist: 16 crypto (IOST, BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, LINK, DOT, SUI, ARB, OP, TON, NEAR, LTC) + 9 equities (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, TSLA, AMZN, GOOGL, META, SPY, QQQ)
- AI trade score: 0-100 composite over momentum, technical setup, volume, news sentiment, on-chain activity, risk
- Position Guardian: server-enforced paper bracket/OCO stops and targets, fresh-quote watchdog health, and verified automatic-exit receipts that do not depend on the agent staying online
- Agent Runtime Reliability: owner-bound 30-second heartbeats, readiness leases, mission checkpoints, exact-checkpoint restart recovery, and fail-closed new mission exposure for enrolled agents
- Agent Runtime Supervisor: deterministic 20-second lease renewal, write-ahead exact retries, private checkpoint recovery, graceful draining, and Docker health evidence without trading authority
- Agent Incident & Recovery Center: deduplicated runtime alerts, automatic offline/recovery-failure quarantine, structured timelines, and owner-only release after verified recovery
- Agent Safety Playbook & SLO Center: honest mission-readiness coverage, 30-day error budget, multi-window burn alerts, and deterministic non-executing recovery guidance
- AITT Verified Agent Benchmark: private-by-default reproducible paper tests with locked manifests, causal trace coverage, baseline comparisons and tamper-evident scorecards; benchmarks never grant execution authority
- Machine-readable interfaces expose structured evidence; check each response's provenance, freshness and missing-data fields. Hash integrity does not establish source truth or profitability.

## Important caveats

- Paper execution only. Autopilot trades simulated fills at live prices.
- Stocks data is delayed (Yahoo); crypto is near-real-time (OKX/KuCoin/Gate).
- Autopilot supports requireApproval mode: entries queue as proposals and wait for a human/agent to approve or reject before executing.
- Not financial advice.
